bio: Situated on the western shore of Lake Bolsena, Pepe Nero is a small restaurant with modern furnishings and a maritime air, where attentive and professional service allows guests to appreciate the excellent cuisine (mainly fish and seafood) to the full. Don’t miss the cavatelli pasta with a mussel sauce flavoured with burnt lemon, or the fresh and fragrant fried squid served in a cardboard box. The wine list features labels from the region and further afield, while a small terrace offers lakeside dining right on the beach....
